fixes.explanation: Nice guess, friend, but James never says a word about pay. The reason he gives is that “…we who teach will be judged more strictly.” (James 3:1) That's a heavier thing than a small paycheck. James counts himself in with that "we," so he's not pointing at anybody from a distance.

True. James says, “In the same way, the tongue is a small part of the body, but it boasts of great things.” (James 3:5) Same pattern as the bit and the rudder: small part, big effect. He's putting the tongue right next to those two.

Yes, a forest. James says, “Consider how small a spark sets a great forest ablaze.” (James 3:5) One little spark, and a whole forest is in trouble. That's what a small tongue can do with a few words, kind of like one text sent at the wrong moment.
